gaps: On a private sale the excise tax uses the N.A.D.A. value when the declared price is below 80% of the N.A.D.A. average trade-in or wholesale value; the form does not ask the book value, so the engine taxes the price.

The reduced registration fee applies after five years of registration counted from the date the vehicle was first registered; the engine counts the five years from the model year (age 5 and over), which can differ by up to a year.
Albuquerque-Bernalillo County Air Care stations set and post their own emissions test price (the city says it is usually about $30 plus tax); the test is shown without an amount.

The New Mexico MVD website could not be opened from our location for this release; every MVD figure was read in the official statutes (NMSA 1978 on NMOneSource, the New Mexico Compilation Commission) and in the Taxation and Revenue Department's pages.
No legal cap on dealer documentation fees was found in the Motor Vehicle Code or the Motor Vehicle Excise Tax Act; type the dealer's fee. Whether that fee bears gross receipts tax is not computed.
Optional costs are left out: the 5% discount for renewing online or by phone, the save our children's sight check-off and special plates.

summary.docFeeNote: No cap found in New Mexico law; type the dealer's fee.

tax.note: 4% of the price paid, less the trade-in allowance.

cycle.label: MVD administrative fee (per transaction)

nm._src: NMSA 66-6-2 (2026 amendment, effective July 1, 2026) and 66-6-6.4 (effective January 1, 2027)

singular: New Mexico charges no sales tax on a car: it levies a 4% motor vehicle excise tax on the price paid, due when the title is applied for [mvet].
A trade-in allowance may be deducted from the price before the 4% is applied [mvet-law].
On a private sale, the excise tax uses the N.A.D.A. value when the declared price is below 80% of the N.A.D.A. average trade-in or wholesale value [mvet].
Titling more than 90 days after the transfer adds a 50% penalty to the excise tax, which raises the effective rate to 6% [mvet].
Passenger registration fees rose on July 1, 2026, the first increase since 2004: $70 a year for a car over 3,000 lb in its first five years, $56.25 after that [reg-fee].
A car of 2,000 lb or less pays $33.75 a year, and one of 2,001 to 3,000 lb pays $48.75, falling to $26.25 and $38.75 after five years of registration [reg-fee].
Every registration also carries a $1.50 tire recycling fee, a $2 additional fee and a 50-cent beautification fee [addl-fees].
From January 1, 2027, electric cars pay an extra $70 a year and plug-in hybrids $35, rising to $90 and $45 from 2029 [ev-fee].
Cars can be registered for one year or two, and the two-year fee is twice the yearly fee [two-year].
Cars registered in Albuquerque-Bernalillo County need an Air Care emissions test; fully electric cars are exempt and new cars are exempt for 4 years [air-care].

mvet.name: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department, Motor Vehicle Excise Tax
mvet.quote: The tax is 4% of the price paid for the vehicle less any trade-in credit. For non-dealer sales, however, the N.A.D.A. value is used if the declared purchase price of the vehicle is lower than 80% of the N.A.D.A. average trade-in or wholesale value.

mvet-law.name: NMSA 1978 § 7-14-4, Determination of amount of motor vehicle excise tax (NMOneSource)
mvet-law.quote: The rate of the motor vehicle excise tax is four percent and is applied to the price paid for the vehicle. ... However, allowances granted for vehicle trade-ins may be deducted from the price paid or the reasonable value of the vehicle purchased.

reg-fee.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-6-2, Passenger vehicles; registration fees (as amended by Laws 2026, ch. 4, effective July 1, 2026)
reg-fee.quote: C. for a vehicle whose gross factory shipping weight is more than three thousand pounds, seventy dollars ($70.00); provided, however, that after five years of registration ... the fee is fifty-six dollars twenty-five cents ($56.25); and D. ... a tire recycling fee of one dollar fifty cents ($1.50).

addl-fees.name: NMSA 1978 §§ 66-6-6.1 and 66-6-6.2, Additional registration fee; beautification fee
addl-fees.quote: there is imposed an additional fee of two dollars ($2.00) for each twelve-month period ... there is imposed on each registration, for each year covered by the registration, a beautification fee of fifty cents ($.50)

admin-fee.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-2-16, Administrative fees
admin-fee.quote: The fee shall be two dollars ($2.00) for each transaction performed by an agent or the department and shall be collected in addition to all other fees and taxes imposed.

title-fee.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-6-19, Vehicle transaction fees
title-fee.quote: For any transaction concerning the initial issuance, transfer or revocation of a title or registration, including filing and recording documents, releasing liens and certifying copies, the division shall charge three dollars ($3.00).

two-year.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-3-20.1, Extended registration periods
two-year.quote: All vehicles, motorcycles or trucks with a declared gross weight of twenty-six thousand pounds or less may be registered for a period of two years ... The fee for a two-year registration shall be twice the fee for a one-year registration.

ev-fee.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-6-6.4, Additional registration fee; electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (effective January 1, 2027)
ev-fee.quote: (1) beginning January 1, 2027 and prior to January 1, 2028, seventy dollars ($70.00); (2) beginning January 1, 2028 and prior to January 1, 2029, eighty dollars ($80.00); and (3) on and after January 1, 2029, ninety dollars ($90.00).

online.name: NMSA 1978 § 66-6-13, Fee incentive for registration by alternative means
online.quote: After the initial registration of a vehicle, if an owner of a vehicle renews the registration of the vehicle by internet or telephone, the registration fees shall be reduced by five percent.

press.name: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department and NMDOT, press release of June 29, 2026
press.quote: Beginning July 1, passenger vehicle registration fees will increase by 25% ... New Mexico has not raised rates since 2004

air-care.name: City of Albuquerque, Vehicle Emissions Testing (Air Care)
air-care.quote: Testing fees are set by the individual test stations and are usually about $30 plus tax. ... Dedicated, fully-electric vehicles are not subject to testing. An emissions test is also required at change of ownership.
